reason: Research was thin. The index has almost no October 19-23 2026 coverage, so I could not confirm why XLI is down 8.2% on this book, though industrials were the weakest sector in the week of 2026-10-05 (XLI +0.36% vs. the S&P +1.15%). XLE is +17% and the strongest contributor, and energy kept rising through mid-October, which supports holding it. The defensive value and low-vol sleeve (VTV, IWD, USMV, SCHV) and the PSQ short still fit the mandate. Acting on XLI now would mean selling a loss on thin evidence and paying churn on the whole book. No stop-loss is set on the XLI leg, so I am holding with the position unchanged and will reassess if it keeps weakening or a verifiable catalyst appears.
